developmentNotes: Initial shutdown fixture lacked the new startup dependency, timed out, then was corrected and passed; no data guard report was produced by that failure.
Initial Node options probe used Windows backslashes that were parsed incorrectly; absolute paths normalized to forward slashes before verified Node/Electron/worker execution.
Old ASAR execution scope was corrected explicitly; copying a module into a stage is not evidence it ran.
Migration/first-backup auxiliary failures after a successful primary commit log warnings instead of falsely reporting the durable primary as failed.
limits: Only this settings JSON repository is covered. Identity/mobile-local/other cache repositories and complete migration/rollback journals are still open.
No fsync/directory durability or OS/power-loss promise. Each file rename is separate; process-kill tests do not establish cross-file crash atomicity.
Only startup/re-read observations detect malformed/unsupported documents; existing warm-cache external-edit behavior is not a file monitoring guarantee.
Migration audit retry is in-process best effort; exit before a failed record is repaired may lose audit history. Legacy reader remains supported.
Corrupt archives and crash orphan temps are retained rather than treated as committed data; no automatic broad deletion.
Initial backup failure can leave a durable primary without backup until a later successful retry; warning logged.
R6 physical decode/contention/rotation/PSS, remaining R7 repository/type/feature/cold-stability work, and other R8 dependency/signing/update/TLS/native delivery remain open.
